title: Rebello's tweet promising to open Brazil's UFO archives if the US does

tellings.quote: I know what the armed forces have in their archives. What I can say is that if the US government reveals its documents, I will do the same if I am elected president of Brazil.

plain: The Brazilian politician Aldo Rebelo, presented on the show as a former defense minister, posted a message saying he knows what Brazil's military holds on UFOs and would release it if the United States released its own files. Michels reads the tweet aloud: "I know what the armed forces have in their archives. What I can say is that if the US government reveals its documents, I will do the same if I am elected president of Brazil." If kept, the promise would open a national military archive on UFOs.
